statements.statement: Papers A and C both discuss end-to-end learning approaches for autonomous driving.
Paper A presents a CNN that learns the entire processing pipeline to steer an automobile.
Paper A notes that the trained network generates steering commands from a single front-facing center camera.
Paper C evaluates end-to-end imitation learning as one of three autonomous driving approaches studied using the CARLA simulator.
This theme reflects the investigation of end-to-end learning methods in autonomous driving research across these papers.

parsed.type_evidence: Claims 1 and 3 both describe end-to-end learning approaches for autonomous driving in different papers.
